title: Jobs, cache and rate limits shared through MySQL
prompt: The app runs on several servers and its database is MySQL: DATABASE_URL is a mysql:// URL (for example mysql://app:secret@db:3306/app). Use Inferlo's built-in MySQL support when DATABASE_URL is set, and the in-memory database when it is not. When DATABASE_URL is set, keep background jobs, the app cache and rate limit counts in the database so every server shares them; without it, keep the defaults. The mysql2 package is already installed.
